shortened: O my God, my God! These are Your chosen ones and Your pure ones whom You have chosen for Your love, elected for Your knowledge, and selected for Your remembrance.
Strengthen them through Your eternal might and aid them with Your everlasting confirmations.

order.why: Consider the imagery of heavenly assistance and radiance.
shortened: O Lord! Strengthen Thy servants who are firm in Thy mighty Covenant and manifest Testament through the hosts of Thy Supreme Concourse and a company of Thy near angels. O Lord! As Thou hast illumined their faces in Thy most glorious Kingdom, spread the light of their faces throughout the east and west of the earth and raise their edifice in the nether Paradise. Verily, Thou art the All-Bountiful.

order.why: Read strength, light, and the spreading of words together.
shortened: Therefore, strengthen their backs through Thy conquering power, illumine their faces with Thy brilliant lights, exalt their station, spread abroad their words, and make them among the lights of the Dawning-Place of steadfastness in Thy love.

order.why: Connect confirmation with love, knowledge, and commandments.
shortened: My God, my Lord and my Master! I implore Thee and beseech Thee to confirm every steadfast one, to assist every firm one, and to aid those who have turned toward Thy most glorious Kingdom to achieve Thy good-pleasure, to promote Thy Word, to strengthen Thy sovereignty, to establish Thy knowledge, to reinforce the pillars of Thy love and to make firm the foundation of Thy commandments.

order.why: Join firm steps with chanting verses and setting forth proofs.
Read the particular prayer for Ali’s remembrance and proclamation.
shortened: O my Lord! Assist Thy servant Ali to establish Thy remembrance, to exalt Thy Word, to proclaim Thy Covenant, to spread Thy verses, to manifest Thy proof, and to make clear Thy arguments and evidences.

order.why: Consider the work of steadying steps, illuminating faces, and gladdening hearts.
shortened: O my Lord! Make this servant of Thine a promoter of Thy Covenant, a proclaimer of Thy Word, a spreader of Thy Cause, one who maketh firm the footsteps, who illumineth the faces and gladdeneth the hearts.

order.why: Hear the prayer to dispel grief and establish hearts.
shortened: O Lord! Through him make hearts steadfast and affairs well-established, dispel griefs, and make him a sign of spirit and sweet fragrance among the people of certitude.

order.why: Read purification and service within the petition for mercy.
shortened: O Lord! Purify their realities with the water pouring forth from the clouds of Thy bounties, and illumine their faces with the lights shining from the dawning-places of Thy favors, and confirm them in service to Thy Covenant throughout all contingent beings, and aid them to serve Thy Cause, O my Lord, the All-Merciful.

order.why: Keep the linked forms of service and steadfastness together.
shortened: O Lord! Strengthen them in steadfastness in Thy Cause, firmness in Thy Covenant, continuance in Thy service, servitude before Thy threshold, exaltation of Thy Word, manifestation of Thy wisdom, establishment of Thy proof, and promulgation of Thy Law.

order.why: Consider guidance and piety alongside protection from doubts.
shortened: O my God, Supporter of the sincere ones and those steadfast in Thy Covenant and confident in Thy promise! Aid these, Thy servants, to serve at the threshold of Thy holiness, and make them signs of guidance and stars of piety, shining from the supreme horizon and gleaming from the highest zenith. Make firm their feet that they slip not through the doubts of the people of passion and desire.

order.why: Read service at the Tree and preservation from misleading imaginings.
shortened: O Lord! Aid them to serve at Thy sacred Tree, protected from the imaginings of the falsifiers, and make them firm in Thy manifest religion and steadfast in Thy Cause amidst the worlds.

order.why: Turn from steadfast feeling to acting according to the Book.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy greatest signs and by the Daysprings of Thy Cause and the Manifestations of Thy Self and the Recipients of Thy knowledge and the Mines of Thy wisdom and the Treasuries of Thy utterance and the Sources of Thy commandments and ordinances to aid me in all conditions to act according to what Thou hast revealed in Thy Book.

order.why: Consider the prayer’s account of commandments and well-ordered affairs.
shortened: I beseech Thee by them who have circled round the throne of Thy will, and soared in the atmosphere of Thy good-pleasure, and turned with all their affections towards the Horizon of Thy Revelation and the Day-Spring of Thine inspiration, and the Dawning-Place of Thy names, to aid Thy servants to observe what Thou hast commanded them in Thy days--commandments through which the sacredness of Thy Cause will be demonstrated unto Thy servants and the affairs of Thy creatures and of Thy realm will be set aright.

order.why: Join obedience, nearness, assistance, and shelter.
Read the request for bodily strength to serve and act.
shortened: O my Lord! Strengthen my limbs to arise in Thy service and to act according to what Thou hast commanded me in Thy perspicuous Book.

order.why: Hear the appeal to act as befits the day amid tribulation.
Read the related prayer with its language of opposition intact.
Consider deeds adorned with acceptance.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O Bestower of bounties and Creator of nations, by Thy Most Great Name through Whose revelation the Names were thunderstruck and the people of the kingdom of creation were shaken, except such as were seized by the hand of Thy grace and delivered through Thy bounty and generosity from the clay of idle fancies - O Lord! Thou seest that I have turned unto Thee and placed my trust in Thee. I beseech Thee to make me one of them that stand firm in the service of Thy Cause and to enable me to perform such deeds as may be adorned with the glory of Thy acceptance.

order.why: Join utterance, service, and action according to the Book.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O Originator of existence, by the ocean of Thy bounty and the heaven of Thy knowledge, to cause Thy chosen ones to hold fast to the cord of Thy bestowal, to hasten unto the ocean of Thy utterance, to speak forth the wonders of Thy remembrance and praise, to remain firm in Thy service, and to act according to what Thou hast revealed in Thy Gracious Book.

order.why: Read remembrance and praise in all conditions.
Keep continual praise joined to service.
shortened: I beseech Thee by the Kawthar of Thy utterance and the waves of the ocean of Thy bounty to assist me in all conditions to celebrate Thy praise and glorification and to serve Thy Cause.

order.why: Consider heart, tongue, eye, and face as dimensions of devotion.
Read thanksgiving for recognition before the request for firmness.
shortened: When thou hast quaffed the choice wine of My utterance, say:

My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having guided me in Thy days and enabled me to recognize the Dawning-Place of Thy signs and the Dayspring of Thy clear tokens. I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Book and its words and letters, and by Thy Cause whereby the ocean of knowledge surged before the faces of all religions, to make me steadfast in Thy Cause and firm in Thy love. Verily Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest. There is none other God but Thee, the Mighty, the All-Praised.

order.why: Keep the companion prayer of guidance, nourishment, and steadfastness.
Hear gratitude expressed through a renewed request for strength.
shortened: Give thanks unto thy Lord for this most great favor and say:

I beseech Thee, O my God, my Beloved, and my Heart's Desire, by the Most Exalted Word whereby Thou hast subdued earth and heaven and caused all things to speak, to strengthen me to stand firm in Thy Cause and in Thy love. Verily Thou art the Almighty, the Glorious, the All-Wise.

order.why: Read the response to the traces of the Pen.
shortened: When thou attainest unto the traces of My Pen, say:
My God, my God! Aid me to remain firm in Thy love and Thy good-pleasure with the greatest steadfastness, and grant me the water of everlasting life from the hand of Thy bounty.

order.why: Read the invitation to gratitude and the petition to share the chosen ones’ gifts.
shortened: When thou attainest unto the verses of the Most Exalted Pen, say: "Praise be unto Thee, O Lord of Names, for having made known to me Thy path. I beseech Thee by Thy chosen ones and Thy trusted ones to ordain for me what Thou hast ordained for them.

order.why: Consider an illumined reader speaking remembrance despite doubt.
shortened: When thou art illumined by the lights of thy Lord's utterance, the All-Merciful, say: Glory be unto Thee, O my God, O Thou Who art the Lord of all existence and the Ruler of the kingdoms! I beseech Thee by the movement of Thy Most Exalted Pen, whereby all things were attracted, and by Thy Name through which Thou didst subdue the kingdom of names, to make me speak forth Thy remembrance and stand firm in Thy love in such wise that neither the doubts of the doubtful nor the signs of the heedless shall hold me back.

order.why: Read gratitude for nourishment, guidance, preservation, and healing.
shortened: O thou who art firm in the Ancient Covenant! Stretch forth thy hands in supplication toward the Kingdom of Glory and the Dawning-Place of Beauty, and say:
Praise be unto Thee, O my Exalted Lord, for what Thou hast bestowed and granted, for how Thou hast fed and quenched, for how Thou hast guided and directed, for how Thou hast preserved and healed.

order.why: Hear the named recipient’s prayer with the tongue of the heart.
Read trust and detachment in the direct counsel to a branch.
Keep the Bab’s prayer of unity, humility, and worship in its own wording.
Retain the related prayer from a separate source.
shortened: O God, make us among those who acknowledge Your unity - there is no God but Him - and who are humble before Your signs, who worship and prostrate to the Most Merciful as You commanded prostration.

order.why: Read the reported closing prayer with its appeal to see, hear, and serve.
shortened: O Lord! O Lord! Illumine the Eyes with the lights of the sun of Reality! Suffer the ears to hear the Voice of the Kingdom of Abha under all circumstances. Make us firm in Thy Cause, submissive before the Throne of Thy Majesty Acknowledging Thy Dominion, arising in Thy Service, engaged in Thy adoration.

order.why: Keep the shorter reported prayer in its own form.
shortened: O Lord, O Lord, make us firm in Thy Cause, humble before Thy majesty, acknowledging Thy dominion, arising in Thy service and being engaged in Thy adoration.

order.why: Give the prayer’s language of anguish and affliction room to be heard.
shortened: O my Lord! Graciously assist me to remain faithful and steadfast in Thy Cause amidst all peoples. Aid me to drain the cup of woe, to be immersed beneath an ocean of trials and tribulations, to drink deep from the chalice of affliction, and to be invigorated by the gentle breaths of faithfulness in Thy path, O Thou in Whose grasp are the kingdoms of earth and heaven! Thou, verily, art the All-Bountiful, the Most Exalted.

order.why: Read patience under trials and the good sought for loved ones.
shortened: I beg of Thee, O my God, by those who have fasted for love of Thee and have quaffed the living waters of submission from the hands of Thy bounty, to ordain for Thy loved ones, who under the blaze of the orb of Thy trials have clung to the cord of patience, all the good Thou hast reckoned in Thy Books and Thy Tablets.

order.why: Consider the prayer arising from exile and separation.
shortened: I beseech Thee by this Exile who hath been driven from His native land by Thy heedless servants, and by the burning of the hearts of them that are nigh unto Thee in His separation and departure, and by the cry of the hearts of the believers in their yearning for Thee, to make firm the feet of this servant upon the path of Thy love.

order.why: Hear steadfastness sought amid the imagery of a world shaken.
Read perseverance against swords and spears of oppression.
shortened: I beseech Thee to make me of those whom the swords of tyranny deterred not from turning toward the Daystar of Thy justice, nor the spears of oppression from drawing nigh unto the court of Thy grace.

order.why: Keep oppression and heedlessness within the plea for enduring love.
Read longing and the refusal to be diverted by clamor or tyranny.
shortened: I beseech Thee by the cry of the sincere ones in the wilderness of separation and remoteness, and by the yearning of them that are nigh unto Thee in all regions, and by the Word which Thou hast made a light unto Thy loved ones and a fire unto Thine enemies, and by the Kawthar of Thy utterance which hath flowed from Thy Most Exalted Pen - to make me steadfast in Thy Cause and firm in Thy love, in such wise that the clamor of the heedless may not prevent me, nor the vain imaginings of the aggressive ones, nor the oppression of the tyrannical ones.

order.why: Read love and sacrifice in the prayer for steadfastness amid clamor.
Acknowledge the trembling of believers amid opposition.
shortened: O my Lord! Behold Thou Thy lovers in Thy lands, who have trembled at the onslaught of Thine enemies. I beseech Thee, by the light of Thy Countenance and the fire of Thy love, so to attract them by Thine utterance that they may not be affected by Thine enemies, and by the estrangement of the learned amongst Thy creatures who pretend to knowledge without any clear proof from Thee, or testimony on Thy part.

order.why: Hear the request that worldly veils and doubts not hinder turning toward God.
Keep love and firmness in the face of doubt.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O Creator of the world and Educator of the nations, to make me steadfast in Thy love and firm in Thy Cause in such wise that the doubts of them that have disbelieved in Thee and in Thy signs shall not cause me to slip.

order.why: Read the appeal concerning denial of prophetic testimony.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Name to assist me to be steadfast in such wise that the clamor of the peoples who have denied Thy proof and Thy testimony and have disbelieved in Thy Day which Thou didst announce through the tongue of the Prophets and Messengers shall not hinder me.

order.why: Consider continuing remembrance through trials and religious opposition.
Read remembrance awakening service despite the fear of tyrants.
shortened: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Aid this servant of Thine to assist Thy Cause among Thy servants and to establish Thy commandments and ordinances. O my God! Thou art He Who reminded me when I was silent in Thy remembrance. I beseech Thee by the breaths of Thy revelation whereby the cities of justice and fairness were perfumed, and by the light shining forth from the horizon of favor and grace, to make me arise to serve Thy Cause in such wise that the Pharaohs of the days and the tyrants of the peoples will not frighten me.

order.why: Keep the historical language of disputed authority and broken Covenant attributed to its source.
Read the prayer’s distinctive language of authority and manifestation in context.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou hast made me the Qayyum over all names and the Manifestation of Thy signs between earth and heaven, to make me a servant unto Thyself, one who speaks in Thy remembrance, stands firm in Thy Cause, wields power over Thy servants, and holds sway over those in Thy earth and Thy heaven, that I may remain steadfast in manifesting Thy Cause in such wise that the turning away of Thy servants and the cawing of Thy creatures shall not deter me.

order.why: Retain the invocation of the Pen and its contrasting effects in the source wording.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy Pen which Thou hast made as an ensign for the manifestation of Thy Cause and as a herald of Thy Name amongst Thy servants and as a light unto those who have sought Thy supreme horizon and as darkness and vengeance unto every wicked and vile one.

order.why: Attend to the anguish and accusations in the Last Tablet to America.
Hear the lament over scattered servants in the opening of a longer prayer.
Read the image of burning coals in a time of severe communal trial.
shortened: O Lord! Aid this servant to remain firm and steadfast in that which is hotter than burning coals, for the hosts of violation have spread and the cloud of wavering has risen and the raven has croaked and souls are in severe trials.

order.why: Consider turning attention toward teaching and proclamation amid conflict.
Read unity and protection in the shelter of the Covenant.
shortened: Unite their gathering, honor their abode, and protect them in the cave of Thy Covenant and Testament from the doubts of the Covenant-breakers and the whispers of the wavering ones.

order.why: Hear the shared request for safety from trials.
shortened: Make us firm and steadfast in Thy Covenant and Testament, preserve us from the arrows of doubts, grant us shelter beneath the shadow of Thy protection and safety, and keep us secure from tests and trials.

order.why: Keep the brief intercession for the recipient and friends.
Read the cave as an image of protection.
shortened: O Lord! Make his feet firm upon Thy Covenant and Testament, and preserve and protect him in the cave of Thy protection and safeguarding.

order.why: Join agreement and mercy with the appeal for a way through conflict.
shortened: Lord! Make firm my steps on the path of agreement, preserve me from the croakers, make for me a way out, and grant me and Your loved ones from Your mercy, and protect me in the cave of Your protection, for we have no guardian other than You.

order.why: Consider humility and contrition in the prayer for protection.
shortened: O my God! I beseech Thee with all humility, supplication, imploring and contrition to protect this servant from severe tests and trials, and make his feet firm upon Thy extended path, O my Merciful Lord.

order.why: Read solitary prayer for guidance and assurance.
shortened: How often has he whispered to Thee in the darkness of night, and how often has he called upon Thee in the solitude of days and nights, hoping that Thou would protect him from the arrows of doubts and make his feet firm upon Thy straight path and Thy right way through clear signs and evident glad-tidings.

order.why: Hear the counsel to pray morning and evening through violent tests.
Consider the plea against wavering in the Covenant.
Keep the iron-building and weapon imagery within this historical prayer.
shortened: O God! O Thou Who illuminest the faces of those who are steadfast with the lights of the supreme constancy, and Who expandeth the breasts of those who are firm with the holy breaths in the place of sacrifice!

O my Lord! Preserve him from the arrows of doubts, and the spears of allusions, and the swords of interpretation, through the power of the divine text. Make his heart firm in the Covenant like a building of iron plates.

order.why: Read tranquility beside the source’s figurative language of resisting discord.
Keep service and the strong image of missiles in their source setting.
shortened: Make them, O my God, steadfast in Thy Covenant and Testament, and firm in Thy Cause and the recognition of Thee, that they may arise to serve Thee. Aid them with Thy triumph, and make them the stars of Thy gifts and missiles against every covenant-breaker and violator in Thy dominion.

order.why: Read the flame and arrow imagery as part of the prayer’s conflict language.
shortened: O Lord! Make me a herald of the Covenant, and a piercing flame against the people of discord, and an arrow penetrating the breast of the hypocrites, and a light shining throughout all regions.

order.why: Hear the intertwined pleas concerning enemies, weakness, and illness.
Read the petition for generosity and mercy amid violation of the Covenant.
shortened: O my Lord! Thou seest me among Thy servants who have violated Thy Covenant and Testament. I beseech Thee not to disappoint me from the ocean of Thy generosity and the heaven of Thy bounty. Verily Thou art the All-Bountiful, the Generous. There is no God but Thee, the Forgiving, the Merciful.

order.why: Prays for guidance and shelter beneath the banner of the Covenant.
Hear the blessing on those who have kept the Covenant.
shortened: O my God! Send Thy blessings upon Thy loved ones who have not broken Thy Covenant and Testament, and whom the Manifestations of Thy power and the Daysprings of Thy might have not prevented.

order.why: Consider fulfillment of the Covenant and turning toward the horizon.
shortened: I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy countenance and by Thy Name which none save Thy knowledge hath comprehended, to number me among such as have fulfilled Thy Covenant and Thy Testament, and have hastened unto Thine all-highest horizon - the Station from which the lights of Thy countenance have shone forth.

order.why: Read the imagery of hastening and drinking from bounty.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O Lord of the worlds, by Thy Most Great Name, to make me one of those who have turned towards Thee and hastened until they took the Kawthar of eternity from the hand of Thy bounty and drank in Thy name amongst Thy servants.

order.why: Join strength with nearness.
Consider steadfastness as an adornment among other gifts.
Hear the personified Book’s prayer for male and female servants.
Read those who receive the gifts as guides toward a flowing spring.
shortened: I beseech Thee and implore Thee to make firm the footsteps on the most upright path and the greatest course, and to aid those who have rent asunder the veils of doubt and beheld the decisive verses, and drunk the cups of bounties from the hand of the Cup-bearer of grace in the gathering of divine manifestations, and who have chanted the perfect words and called out in the name of the Lord of the most beautiful names and glorious attributes, and who have guided the people to the sweet and flowing spring.

order.why: Consider prayer for friends offered at the Sacred Threshold.
shortened: O beloved friends of 'Abdu'l-Baha! Two blessed souls from among the servants of the Most Glorious Beauty attained the blessing of visiting the Sacred Threshold, and placed their foreheads upon the ground, and wailed and lamented, and beseeched steadfastness and constancy for the friends, and entreated and yearned for firmness in the Cause of the Manifest Light.

order.why: Read praise and repose in the shade of the Tree.
shortened: And from the Abha Kingdom thou art beseeched to engage in praise of the Incomparable Lord, for thou hast found repose in the shade of the Tree of the Covenant and hast attained the ultimate hope of the people of God, and hast been accepted in His most holy court.

order.why: Hear thanksgiving for guidance and steadfastness already received.
shortened: O Lord! Praise be unto Thee for having given them feet firmly fixed upon the Covenant, for having fulfilled for them Thy promise, for having made them signs of Thy oneness in the world of creation, for having guided them to the manifest light, for having made them steadfast upon the straight path, for having caused them to enter the garden of delight, and for having protected them from the torment of hell.

order.why: Read the group’s humility, purification, and expanding hearts.
shortened: O Lord, Lord! These are a band who supplicate to the Kingdom of Thy mercy, and a group who are humble, submissive and devoted before the presence of Thy oneness. Lord! Illumine their faces with the lights of Thy favors, expand their breasts with the verses of Thy unity, and purify their hearts with the water that descendeth from the heaven of Thy lordship.

order.why: Consider the prayer’s deliberate emptying of pride.
shortened: O Lord! I call on Thee with a tongue of lowliness and contrition, with a heart empty and free from pride and vainglory, with anguish, trepidation and desperation, that Thou mayest assist Thy servant, the Chief, to exalt Thy Word in every distant region and in all deep valleys, that he may serve the firm Covenant and attain the highest companionship in Thy exalted Kingdom.

order.why: Return to good character and bearing the Word among people of concord.
shortened: O my God! O my God! These are the company of truth and the band of those firm in the Covenant, the guardians of the Testament in all regions, who supplicate to Thee at eventide and at dawn, who flee from the croaking ones to aid the Covenant, whose faces shall be radiant on the Day of Meeting. Lord! Make them of goodly character, bearers of Thy Word among the people of concord.

order.why: Join steadiness with healing, refreshment, and renewed life.
shortened: O Lord! Make firm their feet, unfurl their banners, heal their ailments, illumine their faces, expand their breasts, refresh their souls, and quicken their hearts through the holy fragrances of Thy sanctity and the sweet-scented breezes of Thy wisdom.

order.why: Conclude the linked readings with a community voicing praise among diverse peoples.

questions: How do these prayers connect steadfastness with humility and dependence on divine assistance?
What different qualities of perseverance emerge through images of mountains, trees, shelters, and rain?
How might the prayers to mend division and dispel grief shape the way firmness is practiced in a community?
What does Psalm 51’s movement from inward renewal toward teaching others bring to a reading of these petitions?
How can the historical language of conflict be read alongside requests for good character, tranquility, and harmony?
What acts of service might give concrete expression to a prayer for strength in a time of uncertainty?

references.note: Read the requests for a cleansed heart, a renewed spirit, restored joy, and sustaining help. The passage then turns toward teaching others. Compare that movement with these prayers’ joining of inward steadfastness and outward service, while considering the distinct penitential setting of the psalm.
